If a body-text task retrieves a supported original document, text is parsed within the same timing budget; file tasks validate bytes directly. The method does not switch engines or output modes after a failure.
TEXT.从官方 v1.1.7 release 获取二进制，配置 MOLI_1_1_7_B: Obtain the binary from the official v1.1.7 release and configure MOLI_1_1_7_BINARY.
TEXT.本方法只使用官方 1.1.7 发行二进制，与其他 Moli 版本分开计分。普通网: This method uses only the official 1.1.7 release binary and is scored separately from other Moli versions. Ordinary web pages use native Markdown; bare-fetch routes for direct documents and media were verified on the release binary. If a body-text task retrieves a supported original document, text is parsed within the same timing budget; file tasks validate bytes directly. The method does not switch engines or output modes after a failure.
TEXT.识别目标页或拦截页: Identify the target page or a blocked page
TEXT.核对稳定文字与完整正文: Check stable text and the complete body
TEXT.测试不点击、不输入、不滚动、不翻页，也不登录。返回验证页、空白页或只有页面外壳都: The test does not click, type, scroll, paginate, or log in. A verification page, blank response, or page shell cannot substitute for the target content.
TEXT.从曾在保存的观察中出现登录、验证、反自动化或访问限制的指定网址取得目标内容。资格: Retrieve target content from specified URLs where saved observations showed login, verification, anti-automation, or access restrictions. Qualification only explains cohort selection; scoring uses independently saved target-page references so a title, opening section, navigation, or a few list entries cannot pass as the full target.
TEXT.文章页须覆盖直接加载出的完整正文；列表页须保留稳定栏目，并取得满足域名、路径、字: An article page must cover the complete body loaded directly. A list page must retain stable sections and return names with real links that meet the host, path, field, deduplication, and quantity requirements.
TEXT.规则只覆盖指定网址首次自动加载出的可见目标内容，不要求绕过验证或执行交互。通过表: The rules cover only visible target content loaded automatically on the specified URL. They do not require bypassing verification or interacting with the page. A pass means this response satisfies the frozen rules; it does not prove that the site will remain unchanged or that every access environment receives the same page.
TEXT.请求成功并取得指定目标页面；正文分区、组合规则和登记为必需的稳定文字均须满足。登: The request must succeed and return the specified target page. Body-region rules, composite rules, and stable text marked as required must pass. Diagnostic stable text only checks retrieval scope and does not affect acceptance. An article cannot return only its title or opening. A list must meet its declared field, real-link, path, deduplication, and quantity requirements. Verification pages, empty responses, and page shells fail.
TEXT.页面正文按登记的正文规则核验；稳定文字只用于核对抓取范围，不影响是否通过；新闻、: Page text is evaluated against its registered body rules. Stable text only checks retrieval scope and does not affect acceptance. Volatile news, dates, carousel cards, repository status, and similar content are not frozen as answers. Historical full snapshots are diagnostic only and are excluded from full-text quality aggregates.
TEXT.页面正文按登记的正文规则核验；登记的稳定文字必须命中；新闻、日期、轮播卡片、仓库: Page text is evaluated against its registered body rules, and registered stable text must match. Volatile news, dates, carousel cards, repository status, and similar content are not frozen as answers. Historical full snapshots are diagnostic only and are excluded from full-text quality aggregates.
TEXT.打开指定网址，取得首次自动加载出的目标正文、列表和真实链接，不进行点击、输入、滚: Open the specified URL and retrieve the target body, lists, and real links loaded automatically, without clicking, typing, scrolling, pagination, or login.
TEXT.按独立保存的目标页面证据登记稳定文字、完整正文分区，以及名称—链接、路径、字段、: Use independently saved target-page evidence to register stable text, complete body regions, and name-link, path, field, deduplication, and quantity requirements. Stable text is explicitly marked as required or diagnostic.
TEXT.先排除请求失败、空返回、验证或拦截页面和页面外壳，再逐项检查本例声明的稳定文字、: First exclude request failures, empty responses, verification or blocked pages, and page shells. Then check the case's declared stable text, body coverage, and composite rules; diagnostic text only reports whether it matched.
TEXT.正文与列表规则及标为必需的稳定文字均通过；诊断文字不影响结论。文章只返回标题或开: Body and list rules and stable text marked as required must pass; diagnostic text does not affect the verdict. An article with only a title or opening, a list below its quantity threshold, or links that do not match real paths fails.
TEXT.每例启动一个独立进程；由 Moli 的默认 done 完成方式决定何时交付内容。: Each case starts a separate process; Moli's default done completion mode decides when to deliver the content.
TEXT.每例启动一个独立进程；动态网站正文统一等待 Moli 原生 DOM 稳定信号，并: Each case starts a separate process. Every dynamic-body task waits for Moli's native DOM-stability signal and enables native page layout and loaded child documents.
TEXT.动态网站正文整类使用 CLI 原生 domstable: The complete dynamic-page body family uses the CLI's native domstable mode
TEXT.本轮 {record_count} 个动态网站正文任务统一使用 Moli 原生: All {record_count} dynamic-body tasks use Moli's native Markdown, --layout, --with-frames, and domstable mode. Apart from the target URL, there are no per-task element waits, delays, extraction scripts, or special parameters. No interpretation model, format fallback, or paid backup method is enabled.
TEXT.本轮100例统一使用 Moli 原生 Markdown Fetch 与默认 do: All 100 cases use Moli's native Markdown Fetch and default done completion mode. Apart from the target URL, no case-specific wait element, extra delay, extraction script, or special parameter is used. No additional interpretation model or paid fallback is enabled.
TEXT.核验初次加载范围：稳定内容锚点（稳定标题、栏目、说明）与条目的必需字段、数量、唯: Initial-load acceptance combines stable content anchors (stable headings, sections, and explanations) with each record's required fields, count, uniqueness, and types. Frequently changing lists, item titles, and prices are checked against declared structure and types rather than frozen snapshot values. An HTTP shell alone fails; rendering, embedded data, and public APIs are all valid implementation routes. Full-text quality is calculated separately only when a complete comparable reference exists. Cases with registered body-coverage rules must also reach 80% token-count coverage in each of up to 5 reference regions; returning only a title or opening section is insufficient. For Ajax | Web Scraper Test Sites, field coverage requires at least 6 price, 6 description, and 6 review values, each belonging to a complete unique record. For React · 商品与分期信息, field coverage requires at least 15 installment entries and 13 delivery entries, each belonging to a complete unique record.
TEXT.新增25例结果审核 25/25；未决 0；75例沿用既有审核记录: Added 25-case result review: 25/25; 0 unresolved. Existing audit records are retained for the prior 75 cases
TEXT.本页合并两个不同日期的 Moli 调用批次，保留每例的真实调用时间。本次仅更换报: This page combines two Moli call cohorts from different dates and retains each case's actual call time. This build only changes report presentation code, makes no new Moli calls, and is not a formal release.
TEXT.Moli Web Fetch 实测：五款浏览器，150 道任务: Moli Web Fetch benchmark: five browsers, 150 tasks
TEXT.解读突出耗时减少比例并增加三张信息图: Interpretation highlights latency reductions and adds three infographics
TEXT.首屏以 Chromium 为基准展示均值、P50、P95 的耗时减少比例；以结果: The opening now shows reductions in mean, P50, and P95 latency relative to Chromium. A results overview and two flow diagrams replace repeated summaries and some procedural prose, and the title now names the subject directly.
TEXT.首屏强调秒数，读者需要自行计算差距。: The opening emphasized seconds, leaving readers to calculate the differences.
TEXT.用未舍入数据计算相对 Chromium 的耗时减少比例：均值 42.8%、P50: Using unrounded values, the report calculates reductions relative to Chromium: 42.8% for mean latency, 46.7% for P50, and 44.3% for P95; seconds remain as supporting values.
TEXT.仍为跨批次的 98 道共同成功任务；统计样本与测量边界不变。: The population remains the 98 tasks passed by all methods across batches; the statistical population and measurement boundary are unchanged.
TEXT.概念流程与总结主要依靠文字。: Conceptual workflows and summaries were mainly presented as prose.
TEXT.增加结果总览、Web Fetch 与 Browser Use 对照、五种交付物流: Add a results overview, a Web Fetch versus Browser Use comparison, and a diagram of five output workflows; provide full-size downloads and a corresponding English overview.
TEXT.流程图为说明性示意，六组案例仍展示原始证据。图片逐项核对并绑定哈希，不参与评分。: The diagrams are explanatory. The six case groups still show original evidence; images are checked item by item and hash-bound, but do not affect scoring.
TEXT.解读开篇增加综合通过率与六类结果: Interpretation opens with overall pass rates and six task groups
TEXT.五浏览器解读先展示综合通过率与六类任务成绩，正文解释差异，结尾归纳结论。浏览器配: The five-browser article opens with overall pass rates and results for six task groups, explains the differences in the body, and closes with findings. Browser configurations use a comparison table, with consistently numbered sections.
TEXT.Quick Actions 默认最多缓存 5 秒；waitUntil=netwo: Quick Actions caches for up to 5 seconds by default; waitUntil=networkidle2; document download and conversion share one time budget
TEXT.十方法全矩阵复核与评分根因修订: Full-matrix review and root-cause scoring revision for ten methods
TEXT.当前十种方法主矩阵的 1,500 条结果；本轮发布要求机器通过与失败均逐条独立核: This release requires individual independent review of machine passes and failures across all 1,500 results in the ten-method primary matrix. The separate same-window latency cohort is outside result review.
TEXT.全量审查除既有问题外，又确认了四类共因：正文分段按顺序贪心分配会制造假阴性；Ex: Beyond previously identified issues, the full review confirmed four shared causes: greedy region-by-region body matching created false negatives; Exa bare links lacked name ownership while richLinks provided explicit pairs; serialized script state could be mistaken for readable body text; and the DOCX task registered only section headings, so missing tables, calendar content, and endnotes went undetected. Before correction, the review raised 56 disagreements, 2 of which directly confirmed the latter scoring errors.
TEXT.正文覆盖改为顺序无关的全局容量分配；Exa 具名链接题使用官方 richLink: Body coverage now uses order-independent global capacity allocation. Exa named-link tasks use official richLinks, with certified reruns limited to the 10 affected challenge tasks. Readable-body acceptance rejects script-state shells. The DOCX contract registers table, calendar, and endnote landmarks while accepting equivalent Markdown table layout. Every root cause has paired executable controls against both false positives and false negatives.
TEXT.无未决判定。当前主矩阵 1,500/1,500 条均有独立核验；修正后保留的审查: There are no unresolved verdicts. Independent review covers all 1,500/1,500 primary results; every disagreement retained after correction was adjudicated against the complete actual artifact, reference answer, and task contract.
TEXT.当前十种方法的 1,500 条主结果已全部独立核验，未决为 0。审查确认并根治正: All 1,500 primary results across the current ten methods were independently reviewed, with 0 unresolved. The review confirmed and fixed four root causes: body-region allocation, Exa named links, script state mistaken for body text, and incomplete DOCX content landmarks. Only the 10 Exa challenge tasks affected by a request-interface change were called again; all other corrections rescored the original artifacts offline.
TEXT.当前十方法矩阵审查覆盖 1,500/1,500。修正前审查提出 56 条代理与机: Review covers 1,500/1,500 results in the current ten-method matrix. Before correction, the reviewer raised 56 disagreements with machine judgments; 2 confirmed scoring errors whose root causes were fixed first, and the remainder were adjudicated against actual artifacts, reference answers, and task contracts. There are 0 unresolved items. The same-window cohort remains latency-only and is outside result review.
TEXT.旧评分实现可能在代码更新后继续被报告读取；分段正文按参考顺序贪心匹配会让较长实际: A report could keep reading stale scorer output after code changes; greedy body matching in reference order could let longer returned fragments consume the wrong region first; and serialized script state containing target strings could be mistaken for readable body text.
TEXT.报告构建拒绝旧评分实现；正文片段改为全局容量分配且不受参考区域顺序影响；脚本或应: Report builds reject stale scorer output; body fragments now use global capacity allocation independent of reference-region order; and script or application-state shells cannot satisfy body tasks.
TEXT.两类修正均通过公共 score_attempt 与任务判定入口执行正反向回归；保: Both corrections have positive and negative regressions executed through the shared score_attempt and task-decision paths. Saved output is consistently rescored offline without provider-specific or row-specific exceptions.
TEXT.旧适配器只读取裸 links 数组，既无法证明名称与 URL 的归属，又漏用了官: The old adapter read only the bare links array, which could not prove name-to-URL ownership and omitted official richLinks with explicit anchor–URL pairs.
TEXT.仅具名链接任务请求 extras.richLinks，并只接纳 anchor 与: Only named-link tasks request extras.richLinks, and only explicit pairs with nonempty anchors and URLs are accepted. Body headings and bare links are never paired by position.
TEXT.接口合同变化只影响 Exa 的 10 个挑战任务，因此通过认证流程重跑该范围；3: The interface-contract change affects only Exa's 10 challenge tasks, so the certified rerun was limited to that scope. 3 pass; 7 still fail because the actual artifacts do not satisfy the contract.
TEXT.document-05 只要求标题和章节名，导致返回正文叙述却漏掉表格单元格、日: document-05 required only the title and section names, allowing narrative output that omitted table cells, calendar content, and the final notes to pass.
TEXT.任务合同增加来自冻结源文档的表格、日历和尾注内容地标；Markdown 表格分隔: The task contract now includes table, calendar, and note landmarks from the frozen source document. Markdown table separators are treated as layout so complete tables are not falsely rejected.
TEXT.保存产物统一离线复评分：CowAgent 的不完整结果改为失败，Firecraw: Saved artifacts were consistently rescored offline: CowAgent's incomplete result now fails, while Firecrawl and Tavily retain passes for complete Markdown tables. No provider calls were needed.
TEXT.逐项核验又发现两类跨方法根因：易变网页的整页快照会制造假失败；稳定锚点合同覆盖了: Item-by-item review found two further cross-method causes: full-page snapshots of mutable pages created false failures, while stable-anchor contracts overrode the minimum body length and let title-only or summary-only output pass. The reviewer also disagreed on 21 results after overlooking explicit truncation, case and whitespace normalization, or the lack of ownership between separate title and URL arrays.
TEXT.82 个易变正文案例改为以独立来源确认的稳定锚点判定，整页快照仅作诊断；正文合同: The 82 mutable body cases now use independently evidenced stable anchors, with full-page snapshots retained only as diagnostics; body contracts again enforce the minimum-length gate. Both corrections have executable positive and negative controls and consistently rescore saved output. The declared Crawl4AI scope was rerun under certification. Firecrawl dynamic tasks moved from actions, which is unavailable in the current account region, to the official waitFor route; only the 10 affected results were certified and reviewed again. Lexmount CN and Global scores are excluded from the current report, while their adapters and interface regressions remain.
TEXT.无未决判定。当前主矩阵 1,500/1,500 条均有独立核验；21 条分歧均已: There are no unresolved verdicts. Independent review covers 1,500/1,500 primary results; all 21 disagreements were adjudicated against the actual artifacts and task contracts.
TEXT.十二方法全矩阵复核与评分根因修订: Full-matrix review and root-cause scoring revision for twelve methods
TEXT.十二种方法主矩阵的 1,800 条结果；本轮发布要求机器通过与失败均逐条独立核验: The release requires individual independent review of machine passes and failures across all 1,800 results in the twelve-method primary matrix. The separate 240-call same-window latency cohort is outside result review.
TEXT.同类扫描确认多类系统性判定风险：旧评分实现可能被沿用、明确截断正文可能通过、动态: Family-wide scans identified several systematic verdict risks: stale scorer identities could be reused; explicitly truncated bodies could pass; dynamic-task exclusions were missing from executable contracts; compound facts and Markdown relative autolinks could be misread; and challenge-page detection and image-resource rules were inconsistent.
TEXT.共同根因已在评分身份、正文与任务合同、链接规范化、挑战页判定和资源验收边界中修复: The shared causes were fixed in scorer identity, body and task contracts, link normalization, challenge-page decisions, and resource-acceptance boundaries. Each revision binds executable positive and negative controls and consistently rescores affected saved outputs. Image-URL tasks require the declared target; additional page images remain a precision diagnostic and no longer cause failure.
TEXT.最终假阳性、假阴性、核验覆盖和未决数量以本轮独立审查收据为准；收据完整绑定前不得: Final false-positive, false-negative, review-coverage, and unresolved counts come from this release's independent review receipt; publication is blocked until that receipt is fully bound. Declared scopes affected by an interface, version, or request-contract change are rerun with new calls rather than described as offline-only rescoring.
TEXT.修复评测全链路根因并设置全矩阵核验门禁: Fix root causes across the evaluation chain and require full-matrix review
TEXT.当前十种方法的 1,500 条主结果已全部独立核验，21 条审查分歧全部裁决、未: All 1,500 primary results across the current ten methods have independent review; all 21 disagreements were adjudicated, with 0 unresolved. Mutable body pages now use stable scoring points and retain minimum length as a hard gate. Firecrawl reran and reviewed only the 10 dynamic tasks affected by its interface change, passing 6/10. Lexmount CN and Global evaluation implementations remain, but their legacy-method scores are excluded from this report.
TEXT.本轮从任务合同、标准答案、公共评分入口、链接与挑战页判定、资源验收和证据绑定修复: This release addresses systematic verdict risks in task contracts, references, the shared scorer, link and challenge-page decisions, resource acceptance, and evidence binding. Scopes affected by interface, version, or request-contract changes use new calls; scoring revisions rescore the originally saved outputs offline. Final false-positive and false-negative counts are generated from the complete independent review receipt rather than written in advance.
TEXT.上一版只独立审查机器失败，机器通过尚未逐条核验，无法发现被宽松规则放行的系统性假: The previous release independently reviewed machine failures only. Machine passes had not been checked individually, leaving systematic false positives from permissive rules undetectable.
TEXT.机器通过与失败统一使用隐藏机器结论的审查包；任务和审查可见证据哈希均未变化的审查: Machine passes and failures use the same packets with machine judgments hidden. Prior reviews remain valid only when both the task and reviewer-visible evidence hash are unchanged; only changed results are reviewed again.
TEXT.当前十方法矩阵审查覆盖 1,500/1,500，出现 21 条代理与机器分歧，均: Review covers 1,500/1,500 results in the current ten-method matrix. All 21 reviewer-machine disagreements were adjudicated from actual artifacts and task contracts, with 0 unresolved. The same-window cohort remains latency-only and is outside result review.
TEXT.上一版只独立审查 705 条机器失败，1,095 条机器通过尚未逐条核验，无法发: The previous release independently reviewed only 705 machine failures; 1,095 machine passes had not been checked individually, so systematic false positives admitted by permissive rules could remain hidden.
TEXT.机器通过与失败统一使用隐藏机器结论的审查包；本轮以主矩阵 1,800 条逐项核验: Machine passes and failures use the same packets with machine judgments hidden. Publication requires item-by-item review of all 1,800 primary results, renewed review of revision-affected cases, and zero unresolved items.
TEXT.实际核验覆盖、假阳性、假阴性、分歧和未决数量从最终审查收据读取；发布说明不预写尚: Actual coverage, false-positive, false-negative, disagreement, and unresolved counts come from the final review receipt; release notes do not predeclare unfinished numbers. The same-window cohort remains latency-only.
TEXT.旧评分实现可能在代码更新后继续被报告读取；明确截断正文仍可能凭稀疏锚点通过；易变: A report could keep reading stale scorer output after code changes; explicitly truncated bodies could pass sparse anchors; full snapshots of mutable pages created false failures; and stable anchors could let short summaries bypass the minimum body length.
TEXT.报告构建拒绝旧评分实现；正文任务拒绝明确截断声明；82 个易变正文案例只以独立确: Report builds reject stale scorer output; body tasks reject explicit truncation declarations; 82 mutable body cases use only independently evidenced stable anchors for acceptance, with full-page snapshots retained as diagnostics; and body contracts continue to enforce minimum length.
TEXT.新增两组正反向回归并通过公共 score_attempt 与任务判定入口执行；本: Two new positive-and-negative regression pairs execute through the shared score_attempt and task-decision paths. Together these causes corrected 47 false negatives and 7 false positives without provider-specific or row-specific exceptions.
TEXT.旧评分实现可能在代码更新后继续被报告读取；明确截断正文仍可能凭稀疏锚点通过；动态: Reports could reuse stale scorer identities after a code update; explicitly truncated bodies could pass sparse anchors; dynamic-task exclusions existed only in prompt text; and compound facts, Markdown relative autolinks, and Chinese or English challenge pages had boundary errors.
TEXT.报告构建拒绝旧评分实现；正文任务拒绝明确截断声明；排除项进入机器可执行任务合同；: Report builds reject stale scorer identities; body tasks reject explicit truncation declarations; exclusions enter executable task contracts; compound facts are split semantically; and visible link text and challenge-page headings are normalized in shared code paths.
TEXT.每种缺陷都以相邻的应通过与应失败样本覆盖，并通过公共 score_attempt: Each defect is covered by nearby should-pass and should-fail controls executed through the shared score_attempt and task-decision path, without provider-specific or row-specific exceptions.
TEXT.图片地址题一度被拟议成 target-only 输出，可能把已经命中目标、但同时: Image-URL tasks were briefly proposed as target-only output, which could fail a valid page fetch that found the target while retaining logos or recommendation images. Some responsive target aliases also require independent source evidence.
TEXT.资源验收只要求命中任务声明的目标或有证据的合法别名；额外页面图片保留为纯净度诊断: Resource acceptance requires a declared target or an evidenced valid alias. Additional page images remain a precision diagnostic and do not affect binary acceptance. Target lists, aliases, source observations, and resource contracts are all hash-bound.
TEXT.避免把页面级抓取强行等同于只返回一个 URL，同时仍拒绝没有命中目标的长文本或大: This avoids treating a page-level fetch as if it had to return only one URL, while still rejecting long text or many unrelated images that never match the target. Stale scores cannot be published after a contract change.
TEXT.评分、参考、数据集和审查收据可分别更新，若生命周期只校验部分字段，旧核验可能被错: Scores, references, datasets, and review receipts can change independently. Partial lifecycle validation could wrongly reuse an old review, while patching only a final verdict cannot prevent recurrence.
TEXT.每类根因登记正反向可执行回归；参考修订和评分修订分别串联完整输入输出哈希、根因与: Each root cause has executable controls in both directions. Reference and scoring revisions separately chain complete input and output hashes, root causes, and regression IDs; report builds validate scorer identity, task content, resource contracts, and source evidence.
TEXT.评分与参考修订不重发 provider 请求；只有接口、版本、输入或请求合同改变: Scoring and reference revisions do not resend provider requests. Only predeclared scopes affected by an interface, version, input, or request-contract change are rerun, with traceability preserved between old and new calls.
TEXT.旧适配器使用当前账户地区不允许的 actions，10 个动态任务都在服务入口失: The old adapter used actions, which the current account region does not allow. All 10 dynamic tasks failed at the service boundary, incorrectly producing a 0/10 capability result.
TEXT.改用当前公开接口支持的 waitFor，并通过调用前后参考冻结的认证流程只重跑这: The adapter now uses waitFor, supported by the current public interface. A certified run with references frozen before and after calls reran only these 10 tasks; the other 140 Firecrawl results are unchanged.
TEXT.新结果 6/10 通过；新增 10 条全部由隐藏机器结论的 Codex CLI: The new results pass 6/10. Codex CLI blindly reviewed all 10 additions with machine judgments hidden, finding 0 disagreements and 0 unresolved items. The remaining 4 fail because their actual output does not satisfy the task contract.

But they ask different things of an agent. The first starts with a known address and needs its content. The second requires repeated searches, clicks, form inputs, and checks, with each action chosen from the page's current state.
TEXT.Web Fetch：给定 URL，取回内容: Web Fetch: retrieve content from a given URL

TEXT.Web Fetch 不只需要处理 HTML。一篇 PDF 要交回正文，一张图片详: Web Fetch handles more than HTML. A PDF task needs text; an image detail page may need only the original-image link; a direct image URL needs the file itself. Successful retrieval means something different in each case. The five examples below show typical paths; individual browsers may implement them differently.
TEXT.输入 Example Domain 页面，结果应有标题、用途说明和更多信息链接。: For the Example Domain page, the output must include its title, purpose, and further-information link. A title alone or a security-verification prompt does not complete the task.
TEXT.输入《Attention Is All You Need》的 PDF 地址，检查: Given the PDF URL for Attention Is All You Need, check whether the output covers the reference body. The current Moli path uses local pypdf parsing; retrieval and parsing share the time limit.
TEXT.装饰蜡烛列表至少需要 3 条商品名称和详情链接，还要保留指定的稳定页面文字。空记: The decorative-candle list needs at least 3 product names with detail links, plus specified stable page text. Empty, duplicate, or incomplete records do not count.
TEXT.从下载页找到指定资源，交付的是目标地址。页面上有很多链接，拿到导航链接或无关素材: Find the specified resource on a download page and return its URL. Navigation links or unrelated assets do not satisfy the task.
TEXT.输入 PNG、WebM 或 MP4 的直接地址，检查格式、长度和文件指纹。图片说: Given a direct PNG, WebM, or MP4 URL, check the format, length, and file fingerprint. An image description cannot replace PNG bytes. These tasks do not test whether a model understands the image.

General pages include documentation sites, encyclopedias, project descriptions, and standards. Dynamic tasks examine delayed content, subsequent data retrieval, and iframe content; popular-site tasks cover more complex real-world pages and lists.

The ratio of 10 document tasks to 100 general-page tasks does not represent the web as a whole; one task in a small group changes its score by 10 percentage points. Category results and concrete examples help readers judge whether the differences affect their own input types.
TEXT.成功判定跟着任务走，不只看请求有没有报错: Acceptance follows the task, not just the request status
TEXT.一个普通网页任务怎样判分: How a general-page task is scored

Declared equivalent wording is accepted. Verification pages, access-denied responses, and other errors are excluded, and reference body-region coverage is checked.
TEXT.保留 Example Domain、用于文档示例的说明，以及 Learn mor: Retain Example Domain, the explanation of its use in documentation examples, and Learn more or the corresponding link, while satisfying the task's body requirements.
TEXT.只剩 Example Domain 标题；或整页只有 Access denied: Only the Example Domain title remains, or the entire page says Access denied. A normal response still fails to deliver the required content.
TEXT.参考内容独立于被测浏览器准备。对于动态网页，保留初始 HTTP 内容和独立渲染后: References are prepared independently of the tested browsers. Dynamic-page references retain initial HTTP content and independently rendered visible target content, so subsequent loading requirements can be checked. Frequently changing rankings and product pages are assessed through stable text, required fields, count, and uniqueness, without freezing a moment's prices or ranks as permanent answers.

Of these, 750 belong to the five methods shown here; the remaining records cover two other Moli versions. This article uses 1.1.1, the highest-scoring of the three tested versions. That choice was made after seeing the results, but outputs were not selected across versions task by task.
TEXT.任务通过率与正文完整度，分别回答什么: What task pass rate and body coverage each tell us
TEXT.任务通过率按完成题数计算，例如 Moli 的 135 ÷ 150 = 90.0%: Task pass rate counts completed tasks: for Moli, 135 ÷ 150 = 90.0%. Text quality is checked separately. Recall measures recovered reference text; precision measures returned text within the reference scope; F1 combines both. Navigation, footers, and formatting affect these numbers. They measure text overlap, not factual correctness or freshness.
TEXT.一个结果可以满足任务的必要要求，同时带有多余导航；也可能找回部分正文，却漏掉一段: An output can satisfy the task while containing extra navigation. It can also recover some body text but fail because a required passage is missing. Task verdicts and full-text metrics therefore remain separate. Tasks without complete references are excluded from full-text averages; unmeasured values are neither zero nor perfect scores.
TEXT.相同 URL，五种取回内容的方式: The same URL, five ways to retrieve its content
TEXT.这五款软件都能用于自动化获取网页，但接入方式和本轮配置并不相同。比较完整处理路线: All five tools can retrieve web pages automatically, but their interfaces and tested configurations differ. Comparing the complete processing paths explains how each output is produced. Product descriptions below follow official documentation; scores come from this benchmark.
TEXT.Moli 是面向 AI Agent 的 Rust 浏览器，提供网页获取与浏览器自: Moli is a Rust browser for AI agents, with web retrieval and browser-automation interfaces. General-page tasks use native Markdown output. Direct documents and media use the raw-response path, with a local parser extracting PDF text.
TEXT.原生 Markdown，或原始文件＋文档解析: Native Markdown, or raw file + document parsing
TEXT.它的突出结果是文档 7/10、图片 10/10、视频 7/10；普通网页完成 9: Its strongest results are documents at 7/10, images at 10/10, and videos at 7/10. General pages score 97/100, close to Chromium's 99/100. It has the lowest median latency in the shared-success subset. Three W3C pages stop at security verification, while DOCX and embedded viewers also have failures; this coverage is not equivalent to the full Chromium browser.
TEXT.Chromium 是开源浏览器项目，也是许多浏览器产品的基础。本轮以无头模式运行: Chromium is an open-source browser project underlying many browser products. It runs headlessly here, without displaying a window. After retrieving the page DOM, node-html-markdown 2.0.0 converts it to Markdown. The DOM is the page structure maintained by the browser.
TEXT.它在普通网页完成 99/100，且完整正文的找回比例与 F1 都高于 Moli，: It completes 99/100 general pages, with higher full-body recall and F1 than Moli, making it an important HTML-text baseline here. Its document score of 1/10 describes the tested DOM-to-text path on files. Adding file download and a PDF parser would require testing that combined path separately.
TEXT.Lightpanda 是用 Zig 从头开发的无头浏览器，面向 AI 与自动化，: Lightpanda is a headless browser built from scratch in Zig for AI and automation, rather than a Chromium fork. This run uses its native Markdown output.
TEXT.它完成了 92/100 个普通网页和 8/10 个动态任务；三篇 Moli 未完: It completes 92/100 general pages and 8/10 dynamic tasks. It retrieves the body text of all three W3C standards Moli missed and is the only method here to pass the IMDb task. In the separate latency subset, its P50 is 3.49 seconds and its sample P95 is lowest. Scores of 1/10 for documents and 4/10 for popular sites show gaps in this mixed-input sample.
TEXT.Obscura 是面向网页抓取和 AI Agent 的 Rust 无头浏览器，使: Obscura is a Rust headless browser for web scraping and AI agents, using V8 to execute JavaScript. This run uses standard mode and native Markdown output, without stealth mode or an alternative engine.
TEXT.它完成了 90/100 个普通网页、5/10 个热门站点任务，也通过了 Moli: It completes 90/100 general pages and 5/10 popular-site tasks, including the Blender resource-discovery task Moli missed. Its shared-success P50 is 11.69 seconds, the highest of the five methods here. This indicates a longer end-to-end wait in the tested configuration; it does not evaluate modes that were not enabled.
TEXT.Kitesurf 是 Cloudflare 面向 Agent 的浏览器方案。本轮: Kitesurf is Cloudflare's browser offering for agents. This run selects Kitesurf through Browser Run's Markdown endpoint. The client sends a URL to the remote service and receives Markdown, a different deployment setup from the four locally run methods.
TEXT.它完成了 88/100 个普通网页、8/10 个动态任务，并在 YouTube: It completes 88/100 general pages and 8/10 dynamic tasks, and passes the YouTube task the other four missed. Its shared-success P50 is 5.87 seconds, including the public-network round trip and remote processing. This service moves browser operation to the cloud, but hosting cost, scaling, and production concurrency were not measured.

Moli's primary call takes 6.07 seconds and returns 13,028 characters, yielding 72 records with complete fields and unique links. All four text groups match. TEXT.达到数量、字段、去重和稳定文字要求。: Meets count, field, uniqueness, and stable-text requirements.

TEXT.普通网页的任务通过数接近，并不表示全文质量已经对齐。98 个任务具有完整、可比的: Similar general-page pass counts do not mean equal full-text quality. Across 98 tasks with complete, comparable body references, Chromium's mean recall is 99.8% and Moli's is 95.3%; their full-text F1 scores are 76.1% and 71.9% respectively.
TEXT.Moli 未通过的三个普通网页都是 W3C 长标准：CSS 2.1、WCAG 2: Moli's three general-page failures are long W3C standards: CSS 2.1, WCAG 2.1, and XML 1.0. Each returns the same 475-character security-verification page; Chromium and Lightpanda retrieve the body text. Integration tests should include verification-page detection and failure handling, or a tool may pass a nonempty error message to the model as body text.
TEXT.动态网页：五款方案都停在 8/10: Dynamic pages: all five methods score 8/10
TEXT.两道共同未通过的任务，一道在 3 秒后显示引文列表，另一道将目标目录放在 ifr: Of the two shared failures, one displays a quote list after 3 seconds and the other places the target catalog in an iframe. The first tests whether delayed content is read; the second whether retrieval reaches the embedded page.
TEXT.Moli 返回了页面框架，没有交付目标列表。下一次实验需要比较不同等待条件，并检: Moli returns the page shell without the target list. The next experiment should compare wait conditions and inspect the actual target records. Extending a fixed delay alone does not establish a fix.
TEXT.Obscura 在这两题均未完成取页，说明相同失败结果不一定由相同原因造成。当前: Obscura fails to complete retrieval on both tasks, so identical verdicts need not have identical causes. The evidence identifies missing outputs, but controlled experiments have not yet separated network, wait-strategy, and iframe effects.
TEXT.Moli 已有可用优势，下一步要验证稳定覆盖: Moli has practical advantages; consistent coverage is the next test
TEXT.本轮最明确的结果是：Moli 1.1.1 以 90.0% 的任务通过率覆盖了更多: Moli 1.1.1 passes 90.0% of tasks, covering more inputs, especially PDFs and original media files. Across the 8 shared-success latency tasks, its median is lower than those of the other four methods. General-page pass counts are close to Chromium's, but body recall and F1 still trail.
TEXT.对于同时读取网页、PDF 和媒体的 Agent，这些结果支持把 Moli 纳入实: For agents reading pages, PDFs, and media, these results support including Moli in integration tests. For workloads dominated by long HTML text, Chromium remains an important quality reference. PDF frequency, original-file requirements, verification pages, and iframes determine how relevant these scores are to a workload.
Moli's public releases continue to evolve. In UTC, month 9 day 1 saw version 1.1.1, followed by releases in month 9 on days 4, 5, and 8, covering DOM, HTML, retrieval, and rendering changes. For example, 1.1.4 includes a redirect-handling fix during streaming-parser suspension. These are release developments; this article's scores still describe 1.1.1. TEXT.这里列的是完成本报告所需的全部外部准备：账号、官方获取入口和变量名称。变量值、本: This is the complete external setup required for the benchmark: accounts, official sources, and variable names. Values, local paths, login sessions, cookies, and tokens are never included.

TEXT.150 个任务中满足各自验收规则的数量；每题等权。: Number of the 150 tasks that satisfy their own acceptance contract; every task has equal weight.
TEXT.各分榜通过数 / 本类任务数，用于定位总分来自哪些能力。: Passes divided by tasks in each family, showing which capabilities contribute to the overall result.
TEXT.独立盲审覆盖数、审查方法和未决数。: Coverage of the independent blind review, its protocol, and unresolved count.
TEXT.分榜用于判断具体能力。默认按任务通过率排序，点击列名可切换；质量分数与通过率分别: Family rankings show specific capabilities. They default to task pass rate; select a column heading to sort. Text quality and pass rate are calculated separately.
TEXT.指标说明 · 通过率、质量与耗时: Metric definitions · pass rate, quality, and latency
TEXT.表格可横向滚动查看全部列。: Scroll horizontally to view every column.
TEXT.任务结果与耗时进入主榜；全文指标无完整参考时显示 —。: Task verdict and latency enter the primary ranking; full-text metrics are shown as — without a complete reference.
TEXT.静态网站正文、动态网站正文、热门网站正文、风控网页正文和文档正文使用同一评分流程: Static-site, dynamic-site, popular-site, risk-control, and document body-text tasks share one scoring pipeline. Their sources and loading behavior affect case requirements, not metric definitions.
TEXT.接口返回 → 排除空内容与错误页 → 核对题目要求的文字和字段 → 检查列表数量: Provider response → reject empty content and error pages → check required text and fields → validate record count, types, and uniqueness → determine the task verdict. Only applicable checks run for each task, and failures retain the unmet requirements. Image and video tasks use the same request and delivery checks, with resource URLs or file bytes validated by format.
TEXT.满足该例全部验收规则的次数 ÷ 已有验收证据的任务。段落、列表、字段都属于内容要: Calls satisfying every acceptance rule divided by tasks with acceptance evidence. Paragraphs, lists, and fields are all content requirements; there is no minimum F1 threshold. Request failures remain in the denominator. A missing or unjudgeable planned call makes the report unreliable and blocks publication.
TEXT.每例命中的必需文字组数 ÷ 登记组数，再按案例取均值。固定标题、说明、字段标签或: Required text groups matched divided by registered groups, averaged by task. Stable headings, descriptions, field labels, and factual statements may form a check group; volatile lists and prices are not frozen as answers. Tasks without text evidence are not treated as perfect, and coverage is reported separately.
TEXT.接口正常返回的次数占全部调用的比例。接口返回成功，不代表抓到了目标内容。: Share of calls for which the interface returned normally. A successful response does not mean the requested content was retrieved.
TEXT.必须有完整参考，且与输出的目标范围和内容具有可比性；不能用条目数量推算全文 F1: A complete reference comparable in scope and content is required; record counts cannot be used to infer full-text F1. Request failures score 0. A successful request that fails the task is still scored against its actual text, so 0 passes does not imply an F1 of 0. Metrics are calculated per task and then averaged; mean F1 is not the harmonic mean of mean recall and mean precision.
TEXT.仅统计该类型任务通过的调用耗时。列表任务与正文任务均按各自声明的规则判定。P50: Latency includes only passing calls in this task family. List and body-text tasks are judged by their own declared rules. P50 is the median; P95 is the latency not exceeded by approximately 95% of passing calls.
TEXT.资源命中率：资源任务中找齐指定入口的比例；文件取得率：原文件任务中取得可验证字节: Resource match rate is the share of resource tasks returning every required endpoint; file delivery rate is the share of original-file tasks yielding verifiable bytes; metadata pass rate is the share of metadata tasks passing their text checks. Missing byte evidence makes the report incomplete and blocks publication.
TEXT.同时核对登记的稳定内容锚点（稳定标题、栏目、说明）与字段结构、数量、唯一性及类型: Validate registered stable content anchors (stable headings, sections, and descriptions) together with field shape, count, uniqueness, and types—not count alone. Frequently changing lists, item titles, and prices are checked against declared shape and types rather than old snapshot values. A pass does not establish the factual accuracy or freshness of those values.
TEXT.通过任务的平均耗时，单位毫秒。: Mean latency of passing tasks, in milliseconds.
TEXT.通过任务的中位耗时，单位毫秒。: Median latency of passing tasks, in milliseconds.
TEXT.通过耗时从小到大排序，取第 ⌈95% × 样本数⌉ 个值，单位毫秒。: Passing latencies sorted ascending, using the item at ⌈95% × sample count⌉, in milliseconds.
TEXT.逐案例计算完整度与纯净度的调和平均，再对案例 F1 取均值；没有完整参考不计算。: Compute the harmonic mean of recall and precision per task, then average task F1. Tasks without a complete reference are excluded. 0 passes does not imply an F1 of 0.
TEXT.本次调用从发起到结束的时间，包含失败调用，单位毫秒。: Elapsed time from call start to completion, including failed calls, in milliseconds.
TEXT.按执行记录及开始时间生成的稳定本地标识，重测可区分；供应商请求 ID 另见详情。: Stable local identifier derived from the execution record and start time; reruns remain distinguishable. The provider request ID is shown separately when available.
TEXT.识别出的不同条目数，每条需有名称和本站详情链接。: Number of distinct identified records, each with a name and a same-site detail URL.
TEXT.资源任务中，找齐所有指定图片或播放入口的比例。: Share of resource tasks returning every required image or playback endpoint.
TEXT.已测文件任务中有原文件验收通过记录的比例；历史缺少字节验收时显示 —，不是 0%: Share of measured file tasks with an accepted original-file record. Historical calls without byte validation are shown as —, not 0% or lack of product support.
TEXT.文字信息任务中，通过指定标题、发布者等核对的比例。: Share of text-metadata tasks passing required checks such as title and publisher.
TEXT.这是一份完整答案，不是 5 个任务。: This is one complete reference, not 5 separate tasks.
TEXT.独立复查与调用的时间、网络、会话不同；一次拒绝不能证明网站失效。: The independent recheck used a different time, network path, and session. A single denial does not establish that the site was unavailable.
TEXT.已独立核对任务目标；正文、资源地址或原文件的评分依据见本例记录。: The task target was checked independently; this record shows the body text, resource URL, or original-file evidence used for scoring.
TEXT.没有可验证的原文件字节；文字或链接不能替代文件: No verifiable original-file bytes; text or a URL cannot substitute for the file.
TEXT.已返回原始文件，格式特征、长度及目标 SHA-256 校验通过。: Original-file bytes were returned and passed format signature, length, and target SHA-256 validation.
TEXT.本任务验收原始文件字节，不要求 Markdown。: This task validates original-file bytes; Markdown is not required.
TEXT.本例按任务结构或原文件输出判定。: This task is judged by its record structure or original-file output.
TEXT.实际输出存在解码损坏：: The returned text contains decoding corruption:
TEXT.服务未披露更细原因；不能仅凭该错误归责源站或服务内部: The provider did not expose a more specific cause; this error alone cannot attribute fault to the origin or the provider internals.
TEXT.无独立名称参考，未评分: No independent name reference; not scored
TEXT.本次没有可逐条对照的返回标题，因此不显示空表。: No returned titles can be compared item by item, so an empty table is not shown.
TEXT.本次没有交付可校验的原始文件字节。: This call did not deliver verifiable original-file bytes.
TEXT.本例未设置稳定文字核对点，不作文字内容已核验的结论。: No stable text checks are registered for this task, so no claim is made that its text content was validated.

TEXT.完整正文与词语重合评分的参考。: Reference for complete body text and text-overlap scoring.
TEXT.正文抽取的精确率、召回率与 F1。: Precision, recall, and F1 for body-text extraction.
TEXT.独立采集源页；需要渲染的页面另做浏览器观测，通过完整范围校验后才冻结。: Capture source pages independently. Pages requiring rendering receive a separate browser observation and are frozen only after full-scope validation.
TEXT.同一 URL、任务和截止时间；各方法使用其最快的正式任务原生产物路线，保留版本、: Use the same URL, task, and deadline. Each method uses its fastest official task-native output path, while version, output, and hashes are retained.
TEXT.独立重取精确参考页，确认调用期间标准答案未改变；不把参考变化算成浏览器失败。: Retrieve the exact reference page independently after the run to confirm that the answer did not change during measurement; reference drift is not counted as a browser failure.

TEXT.读取给定网页当前首屏加载完成后的整页正文；保留标题、正文、列表和表格，不要求翻页: Read the complete body visible after the target page's initial load. For repository pages, the complete project README is the body target; sidebar statistics are not required.
TEXT.读取文档全部正文，包括后续页面、表格和附录；若输入为文档查看页，读取里面嵌入的文: Read the document's complete body, including later pages, tables, and appendices. When the input is a document viewer, read the embedded document rather than only its toolbar or surrounding description.
TEXT.返回页面中指定正文图片的可用地址；至少必须命中全部目标。额外页面图片计入纯净度诊: Return usable URLs for every specified body image. All targets are required. Additional page images affect the purity diagnostic but not binary acceptance; textual descriptions and the input page URL are not target images. This evaluates image retrieval, not image understanding.
TEXT.返回该详情页或示例结果中的指定正文图片地址；至少必须命中目标。Logo、广告和推: Return the specified body-image URL from the detail page or example output. The target is required. Extra candidates such as logos, ads, and recommendations affect the purity diagnostic but not binary acceptance. Image understanding is not evaluated.
TEXT.返回页面里视频的播放文件或有效播放器入口。视频封面、页面标题和普通首页链接不算；: Return the playable video file or a valid player endpoint from the page. A poster image, page title, or ordinary home-page link does not count. Transcription and video understanding are out of scope.
TEXT.返回可核对的原始视频文件；仅返回输入地址或二进制乱码不算成功。: Return a verifiable original video file. Repeating the input URL or returning binary data as garbled text does not count.
TEXT.返回原始 PNG 图片文件，不接受把图片乱码当作正文，也不接受只重复输入地址。: Return the original PNG file. Binary bytes rendered as garbled text and a repeated input URL are not accepted.
TEXT.先按失败环节区分请求失败、请求成功但任务失败，再按失败类别细分原因。“访问被拒绝: First separate request failures from successful requests that fail task acceptance, then classify the specific cause. “Access denied” does not mean the site was unavailable.
TEXT.只检查标题和几个关键词，可能让“只抓到开头”的残缺结果通过。因此系统按前后位置检: Checking only a heading and a few keywords can let an opening-only fragment pass. The benchmark therefore checks the same complete reference across ordered regions. Every region has a 60.0% hard floor, and at least 4 of 5 regions must reach 80.0%. Matching ignores whitespace, presentation punctuation, and Markdown link destinations; each attempt page shows the reference region beside the observed evidence.
TEXT.评分使用上方完整标准答案和完整实际返回，不使用下面展示的短定位样例。两边先统一大: Scoring uses the complete reference and complete actual output above, not the short inspection snippets below. Both sides are normalized for case and common formatting differences; Markdown link destinations, whitespace, and punctuation are removed before forming contiguous six-character shingles. The reference is divided into 5 ordered regions. Region coverage equals matched shingles in the complete output divided by reference shingles in that region. Every region must reach the 60.0% hard floor and at least 4 of 5 regions must reach the 80.0% target. An output shingle can count toward only one region, preventing repeated text from being reused. Full-text recall, precision, and F1 are calculated separately on the complete text.

At least 1 of 1 region must reach the 60.0% hard floor and the 80.0% target. An output shingle can count only once. Full-text recall, precision, and F1 are calculated separately on the complete text.
TEXT.每组至少命中一种允许表达，所有组均须通过。: At least one accepted variant must match in every group; all groups are required.

TEXT.这里列出正文验收规则和用于范围核对的文字；范围核对文字不影响是否通过。: This section lists the body acceptance rules and text used to check retrieval scope; scope-check text does not affect acceptance.
TEXT.各字段须属于同一条记录，不得跨条目拼接。按详情链接核对唯一性。: All fields must belong to the same record and cannot be assembled across items. Uniqueness is checked by detail URL.
TEXT.具名详情入口：至少 3 条完整且唯一的记录。按登记的稳定文本锚点与页面模式核对稳: Named detail records: at least 3 complete, unique records. Registered stable text anchors and page patterns validate stable headings, sections, and descriptions, together with field ownership, type, completeness, and uniqueness. Frequently changing lists and prices are not compared with old snapshot values; a pass does not establish that those values are accurate or current.

TEXT.常见网页的正文提取：从文章、文档站、百科或项目主页中取回要读的内容，剔除导航、广: Extract readable body text from articles, documentation sites, encyclopedias, and project pages while excluding navigation, advertising, and other chrome. The challenge is finding the correct body boundary without omitting sections or admitting substantial noise.

TEXT.从文章、文档站、百科或项目主页中取回题目要求的内容。导航和页脚是否需要保留，由每: Retrieve the required content from articles, documentation, encyclopedias or project pages. Each task declares whether navigation and footer text must be retained; they cannot substitute for the required body, lists or tables.
TEXT.目标是读出页面内容，而不是保存整份网页源码。正文若已在响应中，普通 HTTP 加: The goal is readable page content, not a copy of the complete page source. When the body is already present in the response, ordinary HTTP plus a parser may be sufficient.
TEXT.项目仓库页以 README 为正文：只返回仓库名称和简介不够；把文件目录、导航一: For a repository page, the README is the body target. A repository name and short description are insufficient, while including the file tree and navigation may reduce precision.
TEXT.这组按正文提取任务选样，没有逐页按渲染方式分组，不能等同于“纯静态网页”。请求成: This family is sampled for body-text extraction and is not subdivided by rendering mechanism, so it should not be read as “purely static pages.” Request success, task acceptance, and full-text quality are measured separately. Site search, clicking, and multi-page browsing are out of scope.
TEXT.这里的“动态”指内容的加载方式，不是文字经常更新。目标正文不直接以完整可读文本出: Here, “rendered” describes how content loads, not how often it changes. The complete readable target is absent from the initial page and requires asynchronous data, client-side assembly, delayed presentation, or an embedded child page. The challenge is finding the actual data behind the shell.
TEXT.这是常见的浏览器渲染路径，可由 Web Fetch 内部完成，无需先手动打开网页: This is a typical browser-rendering path and may be performed internally by Web Fetch without manually opening the page first. Initial HTML alone may omit the body, but directly parsing embedded state, calling a public endpoint, or reading the child page are equally valid paths.
TEXT.Quotes 异步引文页：只拿到页面标题不够，要取得首批引文及每条对应的作者、标: On the asynchronous Quotes page, the page title alone is insufficient. The first set of quotes and each quote's corresponding author and tags are required; fields cannot be combined across records.
TEXT.只测各案例声明的初次自动加载范围，不要求滚动、翻页或点击。执行 JavaScri: Only each task's declared initial automatic-load scope is measured; scrolling, pagination, and clicks are not required. Running JavaScript is not the only valid approach—embedded data and public endpoints are acceptable. Stable demonstration text is still checked, while volatile fields are not frozen to old values.
TEXT.从有风控、登录限制或复杂内容组织的热门网站提取任务正文：既要取得列表，也要保留登: Retrieve task-relevant content from popular sites with anti-abuse controls, login restrictions, or complex information architecture. The result must include the list together with registered sections, descriptions, or stable field labels. A page shell, login prompt, or a few isolated links is insufficient when body checks are defined.
TEXT.接口正常返回也可能只是登录页或验证页。只有到达目标内容，并满足本例条目要求，才算: A normal interface response may still contain only a login or verification page. The task passes only when it reaches the target content and satisfies the record requirements.
TEXT.IMDb：取得至少三部不同影片的名称与详情链接，还须保留榜单标题和“由常规用户投: IMDb: return names and detail URLs for at least three distinct films, plus the chart heading and its description that rankings are based on regular-user votes. Film names, ranks, and ratings are not frozen to old values.
TEXT.不向方法提供站点登录凭据，不操作验证码；某一次访问受限不等于网站失效。标题完整度: Methods receive no site login credentials and do not operate CAPTCHAs; one restricted request does not mean the site is down. Title recall, precision, and F1 measure only textual overlap between returned records and independently recorded names. They do not measure whole-page text, list recall, current ranking, or prices. Titles may also be edited, so a text difference does not directly change task acceptance.
TEXT.该诊断回答“已经返回的条目标题是否完整、干净”，不衡量榜单召回率、实时性或整页正: This diagnostic asks whether titles that were returned are complete and clean. It does not measure list recall, freshness, or whole-page body quality.

TEXT.读取 PDF、DOCX、TXT 以及网页内嵌文档中的文字。与普通网页不同，正文可: Read text from PDF, DOCX, TXT, and documents embedded in web pages. Unlike ordinary web pages, the body may sit behind a file or viewer. The challenge is identifying the document and retaining content across pages, paragraphs, and tables.
TEXT.下载链接只是入口；正文提取还需读取文件内容。内嵌查看器的菜单、按钮不是文档正文。: A download link is only an entry point; body extraction still requires reading the file. Menus and buttons in an embedded viewer are not document content.
TEXT.Attention Is All You Need PDF：需要论文正文并命中标: Attention Is All You Need PDF: the paper body must be returned and checks such as the title and Transformer must match. A download URL alone fails, and extracting only the first page omits later content.
TEXT.衡量文字提取，不衡量原版排版还原、图表理解，也不能据此推断扫描件 OCR 能力。: This family measures text extraction, not fidelity to the original layout or understanding of charts, and it does not establish OCR capability on scanned documents. Obtaining a file and reading its contents are distinct outcomes; full-text quality is calculated separately.
TEXT.定位网页中的目标图片，或取得直接图片文件。难点是区分正文图片、缩略图和装饰图，并: Locate target images in a web page or obtain a directly addressed image file. The challenge is distinguishing body images from thumbnails and decoration while retaining usable resource URLs; describing image content is out of scope.
TEXT.这是含图网页的任务路径。直接图片 URL 属于另一类文件任务：请求图片 → 返回: This is the path for an image-bearing page. A direct image URL is a separate file task: request image → return original bytes → validate file. A URL cannot substitute for the file.
TEXT.含图页面须在实际返回值中找齐指定图片地址；直接 PNG 须交付文件字节并通过格式: Image-bearing pages must return every specified image URL. A direct PNG task must deliver file bytes that pass format, length, and target SHA-256 validation.
TEXT.MDN 响应式图片页：返回参考清单中的两张图片地址。文字写着“这里有图片”不算命: MDN responsive-images page: return both image URLs in the reference manifest. Text stating that an image exists is not a match; a direct-PNG task cannot merely repeat the input URL.
TEXT.资源命中只证明返回了指定地址，不证明图片字节已下载或内容已理解。历史原文件记录缺: A resource match proves only that the specified URL was returned, not that image bytes were downloaded or understood. Historical file records without byte-validation evidence cannot support a claim that a product lacks download support.
TEXT.分别测试网页播放入口、直接视频文件，以及视频标题和发布者。难点是辨别播放器外壳、: Separately test web playback endpoints, direct video files, and video title/publisher metadata. The challenge is distinguishing the player shell, actual media URL, and textual metadata; these deliverables cannot substitute for one another.
TEXT.按题目返回播放地址，或标题与发布者，不要求每题同时完成所有步骤。直接视频 URL: Return the playback URL or title and publisher as required by the task; not every task requires every step. A direct video URL follows the separate file-download and byte-validation path.
TEXT.按案例区分：找齐播放入口、核对标题与发布者，或交付通过格式、长度与目标 SHA-: Depending on the task, return every playback endpoint, validate title and publisher, or deliver an original file that passes format, length, and target SHA-256 checks. A URL is not a file, and none of these tasks measure visual understanding.
TEXT.YouTube 的 Me at the zoo 信息任务核对标题与发布者 jaw: The YouTube Me at the zoo metadata task checks its title and publisher, jawed; the MDN video-page task separately checks playback URLs. Passing the former does not mean the video was downloaded or understood.
TEXT.不测画面理解、语音转写或字幕质量。找到播放入口不等于取得视频字节；历史调用缺少原: Visual understanding, speech transcription, and subtitle quality are out of scope. Finding a playback endpoint is not the same as obtaining video bytes. Historical calls without original-file byte validation are shown as unmeasured rather than product failures.
TEXT.同一 URL、同一任务交付物、同一评测集与验收规则；每种方法使用本轮可获得的最快: Every method receives the same URL, required deliverable, dataset, and acceptance rules. Each uses the fastest official path available in this benchmark; internal implementations are not forced to match.
TEXT.任务通过数 / 实际调用数。六类任务不合成总分；未执行不记为失败。: Task passes divided by actual calls. The six task families are not blended into a weighted score, and unexecuted tasks are not counted as failures.
TEXT.方法各走最快的正式交付路径: Each method uses its fastest official delivery path
TEXT.版本未记录不是可忽略信息；二进制哈希仍保留在环境与复现页。: A missing version is material information; binary hashes remain available on the reproduction page.
TEXT.公平边界在输入、输出和裁判，不在内部形态: Fairness is aligned at inputs, deliverables, and judging—not internal architecture
TEXT.远端方法包含公网往返、排队与远端执行；本地方法包含进程启动和本机资源竞争。不同批: Remote methods include public-network round trips, queueing, and remote execution; local methods include process startup and local resource contention. Latencies from different batches are not ranked directly. The same-window cohort retains every predeclared task and separates all-call latency on a common denominator from latency conditioned on each method's successful subset. It measures the time until the client forms a judgeable deliverable, not engine-only CPU, sustained throughput, or an SLA.

TEXT.来源独立、规则有正反样例、输出可按哈希追溯，是不同的证据要求；哈希本身不证明内容: Source independence, positive and negative rule examples, and hash-traceable output are distinct evidence requirements; a hash alone does not establish correctness.

TEXT.同一次去标签操作会保留文字，但丢掉地址。它可以完成一些正文任务，却不能代替下游判: The same tag-stripping operation preserves text but discards URLs. It can satisfy some body-text tasks, but it cannot decide what downstream consumers need. The delivery goal must determine how aggressively text is cleaned and whether links must be retained. Once attributes have disappeared from the output, more precise keyword matching cannot recover their URLs.
TEXT.这个实验只验证合成输入上的当前提取函数。已保存的 CowAgent 调用没有逐次: This experiment validates only the current extraction function on synthetic input. Saved CowAgent calls do not include a per-call source fingerprint or feed the same response bytes through multiple extractors. The experiment therefore cannot attribute every observed success or failure to this function, or quantify how retained-text scope affects pass rate.
TEXT.后备方法能否发挥作用，先取决于系统能否检出主方法的错误。生产环境通常没有每个新: A fallback helps only if the system detects the primary method's error. Production usually lacks a complete reference for every new URL, so this benchmark's post-hoc scoring cannot be copied directly. Page identity, minimum content, and business-required fields are the trigger conditions to test. If the validator accepts plausible but incorrect body text, a capable fallback is never invoked.
TEXT.这也解释了为什么不能把正文选型直接带到文档和媒体交付。PDF 或 DOCX 正文: This also explains why a body-text choice cannot be carried directly into document and media delivery. Usable PDF or DOCX text does not mean layout or the original file was preserved; an accessible image or video URL does not mean the file was downloaded or its content understood. If downstream needs a URL, validate the URL; if it needs a file, require verifiable bytes. More readable plain text cannot substitute for this check.
TEXT.剧集榜单的名字和顺序可以更新，页面身份、稳定栏目与说明文字仍然可以核对。条目按要: A show's name and rank may change, while page identity, stable sections, and explanatory copy remain valid checks. Records are checked for the required count, non-empty names, and valid detail URLs. A correct title with an empty list—or complete records from the wrong section—can still fail the mixed contract. What is reproducible is the question and its rules, not every answer from one day.
TEXT.通过率衡量已登记的内容与结构要求。只数卡片会让空占位通过；只看字段非空，又可能放: Pass rate measures the registered content and structure requirements. Counting cards alone accepts empty placeholders; checking only non-empty fields can accept mismatched or fabricated records. Even stable-text matches and complete fields do not prove every fact is accurate, current, or exhaustive. Use text overlap only when reference scope is explicit. A missing reference does not erase completed content/structure checks or turn F1 into zero.
