TEXT.该案例中按已登记任务规则判为通过的调用比例；不因缺少全文参考而隐藏任务结果。: Share of calls passing this task's registered acceptance rules. Task verdicts remain visible even when a complete full-text reference is unavailable.
TEXT.全文指标须有完整、可比的参考正文；图片和视频按资源、文件或文字信息核对。: Full-text metrics require a complete, comparable body reference. Image and video tasks are checked as resources, files, or text metadata.
TEXT.按登记的稳定内容锚点、字段、类型、数量及唯一性验收；任务通过率与耗时进入对应主表: Acceptance uses registered stable content anchors plus fields, types, counts, and uniqueness. Task pass rate and latency enter the corresponding primary table; the day's list membership is not frozen.
TEXT.知乎 30 条热榜、大众点评 15 家商户、JustWatch 40 部剧集。仅: Zhihu: 30 trending entries; Dianping: 15 merchants; JustWatch: 40 shows. Only list fields are published; account information and original login pages are excluded.
TEXT.稳定标题、栏目、说明按登记内容核对；频繁变化的名单和价格只按声明的字段结构、类型: Stable headings, sections, and descriptions are checked against registered content. Frequently changing lists and prices are checked only for declared field structure, types, count, and uniqueness; this does not establish their factual accuracy or freshness. Missing complete references do not suppress task verdicts.
TEXT.来源快照与独立访问的条件见各案例。访问受限与网站失效分开判断。: Each task records its source snapshot and independent-access conditions. Restricted access and site unavailability are judged separately.
TEXT.方法参考以下公开项目；本报告使用自己的实时源页快照，不是其官方成绩。: The methodology draws on the following public projects. This report uses its own live source snapshots and does not present official scores from those projects.
TEXT.只有 Kitesurf 的账户级 Cloudflare Browser Run: Only Kitesurf's account-level Cloudflare Browser Run path requires a provider account and credentials. The other six methods use local binaries and require installation plus an explicitly configured executable, but no provider account.
TEXT.通过 Playwright 安装匹配的 Chromium，配置 CHROMIUM: Install the matching Chromium through Playwright and configure CHROMIUM_BINARY.
TEXT.按任务定义验收规则。同组已测方法使用相同的冻结任务与参考，覆盖数量在各榜单列明。: Acceptance rules are defined by task. Measured methods within a family use the same frozen tasks and references, and each ranking states its coverage.
TEXT.所有方法进入同一个评分入口，但按任务交付物验收，而不是强制使用同一种中间格式。网: Every method enters the same scoring pipeline, but acceptance follows the task deliverable rather than a mandatory intermediate format. Web and document body tasks validate readable text; original-file tasks validate PDF, DOCX, image, or video bytes; structure tasks validate fields and stable text. HTML/Markdown links and explicitly paired structured name–URL fields follow the same rules. Request echoes and diagnostic logs are not answers. Raw output and adapter status are retained, and the report layer never rewrites a verdict based on method name.
TEXT.从准备发起该次 provider 调用开始，到形成可送入统一评分器的最终答案为止: Timing starts when the provider call is prepared and ends when the final deliverable is ready for the shared scorer. It includes thread scheduling, SDK/CLI/HTTP execution, remote processing and network transfer, browser rendering and body extraction, local parsing, normalized input conversion, file-byte reading, format detection, and SHA-256 calculation.
TEXT.数据集与参考加载、provider 配置校验、调用间限速等待、最终答案形成后的证: Dataset and reference loading, provider configuration validation, inter-call rate-limit waits, evidence persistence after the deliverable is ready, shared scoring, report aggregation, and page generation are excluded. Provider-reported server timing is supplementary evidence; rankings use client-observed end-to-end latency.
TEXT.这个边界比较的是“拿到本任务最终交付物”所需时间：服务直接返回成品时计完整往返；: This boundary measures time to obtain the task's final deliverable. A service returning a finished result includes the full round trip; a local method stops only after any required download, rendering, or parsing. For body-text tasks, local parsing is timed when a method returns only a raw PDF or DOCX. Original-file tasks stop after byte validation and do not perform an irrelevant Markdown conversion. Every method uses the same outer timer and deadline. Late answers are rejected; non-cancellable calls are isolated, making the batch incomplete and preventing publication.
TEXT.完整正文任务除原有核对点外，按参考正文最多五个连续位置检查字符六元组覆盖：每个位: In addition to existing checks, complete-body tasks measure six-character-shingle coverage across up to five consecutive reference regions. Every region must reach 60%, and normally at least four must reach 80%. All regions are assigned globally under one capacity constraint: each returned fragment instance can count toward only one region, and region order cannot change the verdict. A task may declare different regional thresholds when independent evidence establishes legitimate reordering. Matching ignores whitespace and presentation marks but retains text order; full-text F1 remains a separate observed value. File tasks require byte validation, and a resource URL is not a file.
TEXT.原始快照保留不变；评分参考清除零宽空格、BOM 和软连字符，并检查空正文、乱码、: Original snapshots remain unchanged. Scoring references remove zero-width spaces, BOMs, and soft hyphens, and are checked for empty bodies, decoding corruption, duplicate checks, and whether each check exists in the reference. Passing validation does not prove semantic completeness; source records still define body scope.
TEXT.各方法使用同一套冻结任务与参考。不同批次的耗时不直接排名；同窗速度子集单独标识。: All methods use the same frozen tasks and references. Latencies from different batches are not ranked directly; the same-window cohort is identified separately. Live content, login state, and site policy may change, so results represent only the recorded calls. See Reproduction for environment, versions, and commands.
TEXT.不把“代码有更新”直接等同于全部重跑。只改展示时重建报告；只改裁判且原始输出足够: A code change does not automatically require a full rerun. Presentation-only changes rebuild the report; judge-only changes are rescored offline when saved output is sufficient; a changed reference reruns every method for that task; a new or upgraded implementation reruns that method across all tasks; a timing-boundary change invalidates and reruns the same-window cohort. A full rerun is reserved for changes to global task inputs, call boundaries, or dependencies shared by every method.
TEXT.完整度＝取回的参考词数 ÷ 参考词数；纯净度＝匹配的正文词数 ÷ 返回词数；F1: Recall equals recovered reference units divided by reference units; precision equals matched body units divided by returned units; F1 equals 2 × recall × precision ÷ their sum. English is tokenized by word and Chinese by character, with case and Unicode normalized; only Markdown link text is counted. Values are averaged across tasks with complete references. Request failures score 0, successful requests that fail acceptance retain their observed text score, and tasks without references are excluded.
TEXT.网页、文档使用独立保存的参考正文；仓库以 README 为准，列表只覆盖指定的已: Web and document tasks use independently retained body references. Repository tasks target the README; list tasks cover only the declared loaded range and do not require infinite scrolling or pagination. Login and CAPTCHA pages cannot replace the target body. Terms such as “404 Not Found” inside the reference itself are not treated as error-page signals.
TEXT.媒体网址只证明找到入口，不代表取得文件。文件任务没有另接下载器代替参评方法完成。: A media URL proves only that an endpoint was found, not that the file was obtained. File tasks do not use a separate downloader to complete the evaluated method's work.
TEXT.核验时隐藏机器结论和分数，只提供任务契约、标准答案与完整实际输出；分歧回到原始证: Machine verdicts and scores are hidden during review; the reviewer receives only the task contract, reference answer, and complete actual output. Disagreements are adjudicated from original evidence, and any unresolved item blocks publication. Existing reviews may be retained when task and output are unchanged; changed calls require a new blind review.
TEXT.在评测仓库中执行；从明确指定的持久化冻结证据构建，不重新调用浏览器。: Run in the benchmark repository and build from an explicitly selected persistent frozen-evidence directory; browsers are not called again.
TEXT.保存当前评测代码、任务定义和独立参考；本报告另提供本轮冻结结果供复核。: contains the current benchmark code, task definitions, and independent references. This report separately provides the frozen results for this run.
TEXT.次调用。任务与参考冻结后执行；每个方法内部串行，不复用个人登录状态。: calls. Execution begins after tasks and references are frozen; calls are sequential within each method and never reuse personal login state.
TEXT.“事后核验”只说明留存二进制与官方归档完全一致，不改写成当时已经记录了版本。移动: “Post-run verification” means only that the retained binary exactly matches an official archive; it does not rewrite history to claim the version was recorded at call time. When a moving nightly cannot be mapped to an unavailable source revision, SHA-256 alone identifies the exact executable.
TEXT.本地构建为每个任务、方法和证据生成可独立检查的逻辑路由；这不等于线上部署同样数量: The local build creates an independently inspectable logical route for every task, method, and evidence item; this does not mean the deployment contains the same number of standalone HTML shells. The publisher compiles the report into one reusable shell, shared styles and scripts, and content-addressed compressed data blocks. Client-side routing changes pages, evidence loads only when its route is opened, and complete text over 256 KiB requires explicit user loading.
TEXT.发布清单记录逻辑路由数、源文件数、压缩块数和逐文件 SHA-256；发布门禁会重: The publication manifest records logical routes, source-file count, compressed blocks, and per-file SHA-256. The publication gate reconstructs every file and validates internal links plus original download bytes. This retains item-level auditability without duplicating page shells or loading all evidence at once.
TEXT.；账号变量名称见本报告“账号”页，实际密钥只放仓库根目录忽略提交的: ; credential variable names are listed on Access & setup, while actual secrets exist only in the ignored repository-root
TEXT.。冻结参考、完整重测与核验门禁见: . Reference freezing, complete reruns, and review gates are documented in
TEXT.以方法 A 为基准，可选择一个或多个方法共同比较；方法名可直达该次完整证据。: Use Method A as the baseline and select one or more methods for a joint comparison. Each method name opens its complete evidence.
TEXT.主结果 1,050/1,050；同窗测速 140/140；代理分歧 0；已裁定: Primary results 1,050/1,050; same-window latency 140/140; agent disagreements 0; adjudicated 0; unresolved 0.
TEXT.五方法初次逐项复核: Initial item-level review of five methods
TEXT.排版空白、Markdown 链接换行等格式差异造成假失败，也有不完整正文被放行。: Formatting differences such as whitespace and Markdown link wrapping caused false failures, while some incomplete body text had been accepted.
TEXT.统一规范化与正文覆盖规则，不按方法设置评分特例；纠正 43 个假阴性和 1 个假: Unified normalization and body-coverage rules without method-specific scoring exceptions; corrected 43 false negatives and 1 false positive.
TEXT.无未决判定；当时尚未纳入后续新增的 Moli 版本。: No unresolved verdicts; later-added Moli versions were not yet in scope.
TEXT.六方法路线与盲审复核: Path and blind review for six methods
TEXT.六种方法的 900 条主结果和 120 条同窗测速。: 900 primary results and 120 same-window latency results across six methods.
TEXT.Moli 1.1.3 的直接 PDF 和媒体被错误附加 --dump；挑战页、链: Direct PDF and media calls for Moli 1.1.3 incorrectly used --dump. Equivalent content was also misjudged on challenge pages, Markdown link layouts, and the Feishu table.
TEXT.直接文件改用裸 fetch；统一按任务交付物验收，并对全部输出盲审。: Changed direct files to bare fetch, aligned acceptance on the required task deliverable, and blind-reviewed every output.
TEXT.无未决判定；当时尚未纳入 Moli 1.0.6。: No unresolved verdicts; Moli 1.0.6 was not yet in scope.
TEXT.七种方法的 1,050 条主结果和 140 条同窗测速。: 1,050 primary results and 140 same-window latency results across seven methods.
TEXT.加入 Moli 1.0.6 后需要同口径比较；部分高变化网页参考不适合长期复现。: Adding Moli 1.0.6 required an equivalent comparison, and several highly volatile web references were unsuitable for long-term reproduction.
TEXT.三个 Moli 版本统一路线；八题换为不可变来源，live-025 重新观测并重: Aligned the retrieval path across all three Moli versions, moved eight tasks to immutable sources, and re-observed and reran live-025.
TEXT.document-03 的七条结果；其余 1,043 条结果复用已绑定核验。: Seven document-03 results; the other 1,043 results retain their bound reviews.
TEXT.W3C 的短 PDF 地址已返回 Cloudflare 验证页，历史调用与当前参: The short W3C PDF URL now returns a Cloudflare verification page, so historical calls can no longer be compared directly with the current reference.
TEXT.替换为固定 Git 提交中的三页 PDF；只重跑并盲审该题的七个方法。: Replaced it with a three-page PDF from a pinned Git commit; reran and blind-reviewed only the seven methods for that task.
TEXT.默认冻结证据、当前报告配置、方法路线元数据和核验绑定。: Default frozen evidence, current report configuration, method-path metadata, and review bindings.
TEXT.默认证据仍指向旧评测，机器可读数据又保留了已淘汰的 Chromium 转换器说明: Default evidence still pointed to an older benchmark, while machine-readable data retained a retired Chromium converter description. A new session could therefore rebuild a different report.
TEXT.默认证据切换为七方法最终证据；增加当前报告配置门禁，并把路线说明与实测实现绑定。: Changed the default to the final seven-method evidence, added a current-report configuration gate, and bound path descriptions to measured implementations.
TEXT.Moli 1.1.1/1.1.3 在 document-03、challenge: Three paired diagnostic rounds for Moli 1.1.1/1.1.3 on document-03 and challenge-01, plus a current browser check of the JD search page.
TEXT.document-03 两版重复调用均成功；challenge-01 两版均出现: Repeated document-03 calls succeeded for both versions. Both produced empty responses on challenge-01: all three 1.1.3 rounds failed, while 1.1.1 succeeded once. Both JD search URLs could open after waiting in an existing browser session, but fresh formal calls may still fail DNS or return an unacceptable page.
TEXT.保留正式单次调用和原分数；报告不把两题差距归因为稳定版本回归，也不因当前会话可访: Retained the formal single calls and original scores. The report does not attribute the two-task difference to a stable version regression or rewrite historical results because the current session can access the page. JD remains a session- and network-sensitive popular-site challenge rather than a deterministic capability sample.
TEXT.版本稳定性需要预先设计的多轮重复实验；本报告的主榜仍是每题一次调用。: Version stability requires a preregistered repeated-run experiment; this report's primary matrix still uses one call per task.
TEXT.issue #66 指向的版本时延差异；四个正式差异较大的代表任务各三轮顺序轮换: Version latency differences reported in issue #66: three order-rotated rounds on four representative tasks with large formal differences, plus five local fixed-HTML rounds per version to separate startup and conversion overhead.
TEXT.36 次公网调用均成功。1.1.3 相对 1.1.1 的任务中位数分别为 Web: All 36 public-network calls succeeded. Relative to 1.1.1, 1.1.3 median latency was 12% slower for WebM, 18% slower for RFC text, 13% slower for the HTML table, and 6% faster for the rendered page. A single version's HTML-table calls still ranged from about 5.9 to 32.7 seconds. Local fixed-page medians were 65 ms for 1.0.6, 56 ms for 1.1.1, and 57 ms for 1.1.3.
TEXT.把 issue 定位为需要继续追踪的公网抓取长尾线索，而不是已确认的版本回退；报: Classified the issue as a public-network tail-latency signal requiring further study, not a confirmed version regression. Added diagnostic scope, rotation order, and local controls without changing formal single-call results.
TEXT.现有适配器的原生抓取计时仍同时包含网络、页面等待和浏览器内部处理，尚不能把公网差: The current adapter's native-fetch timing still combines network transfer, page waiting, and browser-internal processing, so public-network differences cannot be reduced to one cause. A product-regression conclusion requires a separate preregistered repeated-run performance experiment.
TEXT.四个差异最大的代表任务、三个 Moli 版本；三轮轮换共 36 次物理调用，纠正: Four representative tasks with the largest differences across three Moli versions; 36 physical calls in three rotated rounds corrected latency for 12 authoritative logical results.
TEXT.旧主矩阵的少量极端耗时会显著扭曲各版本整体均值和 P95；这些差异不能由内容得分: A few extreme latencies in the old primary matrix materially distorted each version's overall mean and P95; content scores and fixed version overhead could not explain them.
TEXT.固定同一四题和三个版本，统一采用第三轮而非各自最快轮；只替换耗时与阶段计时，正文: Fixed the same four tasks and three versions and selected round three uniformly rather than each version's fastest round. Only elapsed and stage timing changed; body text, hashes, scores, and verdicts remain unchanged. Old values, all 36 calls, and the selection rule are retained in the correction receipt.
TEXT.这仍是针对已识别异常的纠正，不是全 150 题重复性能实验；主榜延迟可用于本轮观: This remains a correction of identified anomalies, not a repeated performance experiment across all 150 tasks. Primary-ranking latency supports observations for this run but cannot be extrapolated to stable tail latency or an SLA.
TEXT.最终报告纳入 1,050 次调用。任务与参考冻结后执行；每个方法内部串行，不复用: The final report includes 1,050 calls. Execution began after tasks and references were frozen; calls were sequential within each method and did not reuse personal login state.
TEXT.静态网页通过数：chromium 99/100；kitesurf 88/100；: General-web passes: chromium 99/100; kitesurf 88/100; lightpanda 92/100; Moli 1.1.1 97/100; Moli 1.0.6 97/100; Moli 1.1.3 97/100; obscura 90/100. The overall ranking counts all 150 tasks equally. Each of the six family rankings is interpreted separately, and neither latency nor text quality is blended into overall task pass rate.
TEXT.三版使用相同路线；当前总通过数为 Moli 1.0.6 134/150、Moli: All three versions use the same retrieval path. Current overall passes are Moli 1.0.6 134/150, Moli 1.1.1 135/150, and Moli 1.1.3 133/150; document-text passes are 7/10, 7/10, and 6/10. This run does not show a monotonic improvement with version number. In three independent paired diagnostic rounds, both compared versions scored 3/3 on document-03; on challenge-01, 1.1.1 scored 1/3 and 1.1.3 scored 0/3, with every failure producing an empty response. Three order-rotated reruns on the four largest formal latency differences put 1.1.3 task medians between 6% faster and 18% slower than 1.1.1, with substantial overlap; five local fixed-page rounds measured 57 ms versus 56 ms. Public-network tails therefore occur mainly during native retrieval and page waiting and may still include policy differences, but do not establish a general core-performance regression. The corrected primary ranking uses round three uniformly for the same four tasks across all three versions, never each version's fastest response; prior timing and every diagnostic round remain bound by the correction receipt.
TEXT.Wikipedia 单页实测。原生路径不会虚构 HTML/转换拆分；Cloudf: Single-page Wikipedia measurement. Native-output paths do not invent an HTML/conversion split. Cloudflare browser_ms_used is a server-side billing diagnostic, not client-observed end-to-end latency; missing stage data on timeout is shown as —.
TEXT.远端 Kitesurf 包含公网往返、排队与远端执行；本地方法包含进程启动和本机: Remote Kitesurf includes public-network round trips, queueing, and remote execution; local methods include process startup and local resource contention. Latency from different batches is not ranked directly. Speed conclusions use only tasks that both methods passed in the same time window. The metric is time for the client to receive acceptable Markdown—not isolated engine CPU time, sustained throughput, or an SLA.
TEXT.每次新进程或新上下文，不复用个人会话；本轮每题一次且未重试。后续若预先启用一次失: Use a fresh process or context for every call without reusing personal sessions. This run made one call per task with no retries. A future run may predeclare one failure retry, but must retain both physical calls and use the final response rather than selecting the better one.
TEXT.计时外记录批次前后版本与 SHA-256，身份变化直接失败；每次调用绑定该身份。: Record versions and SHA-256 before and after each batch outside the timer. Identity drift fails the batch, and every call binds that identity. Post-run recovery is disclosed separately from runtime records; no commit is guessed when a nightly cannot be mapped.
TEXT.速度仅使用 8/20 个全部 7 种方法共同通过的同窗任务；这是小样本探索性比较: Latency uses only the 8/20 same-window tasks passed by all 7 methods. This is an exploratory small-sample comparison. Cross-batch latency in the primary results remains a per-call diagnostic and does not enter this ranking.
TEXT.同窗速度子集：预先声明 20 题，7 种方法共同通过 8 题；所有方法使用完全相: Same-window latency cohort: 20 tasks were declared in advance and all 7 methods passed 8; every method is compared on exactly the same successful sample. With fewer than 20 observations, P95 is only a diagnostic for this sample and not a stable tail-latency estimate.
TEXT.逐次词级指标的算术平均，包含已测失败调用；未通过任务不会把已有重合归零。完整度与: Arithmetic means of per-call text metrics include measured calls that failed task acceptance; a failed task does not erase observed overlap. Both recall and precision are bounded by the declared reference scope.
TEXT.完整度、纯净度与 F1 是参考范围内的词级诊断，不证明逐句语义或实时事实。任务未: Recall, precision, and F1 are text-overlap diagnostics within the reference scope; they do not establish sentence-level meaning or current facts. Useful text recovered by a failed task is not forced to zero, and tasks without complete references are shown as unmeasured.
TEXT.动态任务通过数：chromium 8/10；kitesurf 8/10；ligh: Rendered-web passes: chromium 8/10; kitesurf 8/10; lightpanda 8/10; Moli 1.1.1 8/10; Moli 1.0.6 8/10; Moli 1.1.3 8/10; obscura 8/10. Browser rendering, embedded page state, and public page data endpoints are valid. Per-task exceptions, switching implementations after failure, and assigning another retriever's result to the current method are not.
TEXT.动态网页逐例验收。延迟、异步取数与 iframe 分别检查；固定 DOMCont: Rendered-web tasks are accepted individually. Delayed presentation, asynchronous data, and iframes are checked separately; a fixed DOMContentLoaded event is not evidence that content is complete.
TEXT.主结果全部输出 1050/1050；同窗测速全部输出 140/140；未决 0。: Primary outputs are complete at 1050/1050; same-window latency outputs are complete at 140/140; unresolved items: 0. Both passing and failing results received independent item-level review. Review rounds and corrections appear on the Review page.
TEXT.报告保存任务 ID、原始输出、哈希、运行 ID、方法版本或版本缺口、参数、计时与: The report retains task ID, raw output, hashes, run ID, method version or version gap, parameters, timing, and reference source. Body-region pages show each reference region, minimum requirement, observed matches, and missing text directly. Environment, batches, code, and commands are centralized on Reproduction rather than repeated across pages.
TEXT.参评方法的官方能力、价格、接口与开源采用；实测表现见各方法执行记录。: Official capabilities, pricing, interfaces, and open-source adoption for the evaluated methods. Measured performance is reported in each method's execution records.
TEXT.Kitesurf 使用 Cloudflare 账户级 Browser Run /: Kitesurf uses Cloudflare's account-level Browser Run /markdown API. Latency includes public-network round trips, remote queueing, and execution.
TEXT.Lightpanda、Obscura 与三个 Moli 版本的普通网页使用 CL: Lightpanda, Obscura, and all three Moli versions use CLI body output for ordinary web pages. Direct document and media URLs use bare fetch for every Moli version: body tasks parse within the deadline, while file tasks validate bytes.
TEXT.Chromium 152 由 Playwright 取完整渲染 DOM，再用 n: Playwright retrieves the complete rendered DOM from Chromium 152, then node-html-markdown 2.0.0 converts it. None of the seven methods calls a model.
TEXT.Lightpanda、Obscura 与 Moli 1.1.1 的普通网页使用: Lightpanda, Obscura, and Moli 1.1.1 use CLI body output for general pages. Moli uses bare fetch for direct document and media URLs: body tasks parse within the budget, while file tasks validate bytes.
TEXT.截至 2026-09-07，Cloudflare 尚未发布 Kitesurf 源: As of 2026-09-07, Cloudflare has not released Kitesurf source code or a self-hosting package. This benchmark can test it only remotely through account-level Browser Run, so it is not treated as a local open-source browser.
TEXT.Cloudflare 官方博客表示计划在准备好后开源，并希望允许客户部署到自己的: Cloudflare's official blog states an intention to open-source Kitesurf when ready and to let customers deploy it in their own accounts. That is a future plan, not a current capability.

TEXT.本地浏览器；无托管调用单价: Local browser; no managed per-call price
TEXT.网页与文档任务由 --dump markdown 返回原生 Markdown；直: Webpage and document tasks use --dump markdown to return native Markdown. Direct media files return original bytes; wait conditions do not extract content.
TEXT.本地 CLI；无托管 API 单价: Local CLI; no managed API unit price
TEXT.本地开源库；非云套餐: Local open-source library; no cloud plan
TEXT.计算、浏览器、网络及代理成本自担；商业云服务价格不能当成本地调用的费用。: The caller pays compute, browser, network, and proxy costs. Commercial cloud prices do not represent local-call costs.

TEXT.实际版本和接口见运行记录；下方链接指向官方说明。: See the run records for the actual version and interface. The links below point to official documentation.
TEXT.所有页面类任务都取得完整渲染 DOM，再使用 node-html-markdow: Every webpage task obtains the complete rendered DOM and converts it to Markdown with node-html-markdown 2.0.0. No resource-extraction script, private viewer object such as PDF.js, or external document parser is used. Page retrieval, DOM conversion, and original-file reads all count toward latency. Original bytes, HTML, and converter hashes are retained.
TEXT.网页正文、嵌入文档以及网页中的图片或视频信息都使用指定 Kitesurf 的 B: Webpage body text, embedded documents, and image or video information use native Browser Run Markdown from the specified Kitesurf. Direct documents also use the official Markdown interface; direct files use official CDP to obtain original responses. Workers AI document conversion is excluded from Kitesurf results. Client latency includes public-network round trips, queuing, and execution.
TEXT.网页正文、嵌入文档以及网页中的图片或视频信息都使用浏览器原生 Markdown。: Webpage body text, embedded documents, and image or video information use the browser's native Markdown. Direct files use its existing original-response interface. Failures do not trigger output switching, a shared DOM script, or an external service to supply missing text. HTTP status and final URL remain empty when the interface does not provide them.
TEXT.网页、文档正文、结构与网页内嵌媒体任务: Webpage, document-body, structured, and embedded-media tasks
TEXT.直接取得 Markdown；直接 PDF/DOCX 不提供可读正文时失败: Obtain Markdown directly; direct PDF/DOCX tasks fail without readable body text
TEXT.只等待，不抽取或拼接正文: Wait only; do not extract or assemble body text
TEXT.网页与文档任务为原生 Markdown；直接文件为原始字节: Native Markdown for webpage and document tasks; original bytes for direct files
TEXT.使用本轮绑定提交构建的二进制；提交、构建环境与 SHA-256 见环境与复现。: Use the binary built from this run's bound commit. See Reproduction for the commit, build environment, and SHA-256.
TEXT.假设仅使用 /markdown，全部用量可计费；按响应头 X-Browser-M: Assumes exclusive use of /markdown and that all usage is billable, timed by the X-Browser-Ms-Used response header. Marginal price per thousand pages = seconds per page × $0.025, excluding the monthly minimum, included duration, and monthly rounding.
TEXT.月支出＝$5＋$0.09 × max(0, round(月浏览器小时数)−10): Monthly spend = $5 + $0.09 × max(0, round(monthly browser hours) − 10), with half-hours rounded up. This includes only the Workers base monthly fee and browser duration; if paid Workers is already in use, the incremental cost should not add the $5 again. The bill is not estimated from the leaderboard's client-side latency.
TEXT.本轮本地 CLI；无托管 API 单价: Local CLI in this run; no hosted API unit price
TEXT.本轮本地开源库；非云套餐: Local open-source library in this run; not a cloud plan
TEXT.计算、浏览器、网络及代理成本自担；商业云服务价格不能当成本轮本地调用的费用。: Compute, browser, network, and proxy costs are borne by the user; commercial cloud-service pricing cannot be treated as the cost of this run's local calls.
TEXT.本轮内置或本地实现: Built-in or local implementation in this run
TEXT.本轮接口与实现 ↗: API and implementation used in this run ↗
TEXT.建议以“成功取得一个 URL 的内容”为基础计费单位，前台显示每千页价格；后台可: Use ‘successfully retrieving content for one URL’ as the basic billing unit and show the price per thousand pages to users. Credits may be used for internal accounting, but the conversion for each capability should be public. Do not charge simply by HTTP request count: one batch call may contain multiple URLs, and one retrieval may involve retries.
TEXT.基础取数与增强能力分开: Separate basic retrieval from enhanced capabilities
TEXT.普通正文是一档；高成本代理、长时间交互、OCR、模型结构化抽取单列加价。不能只因: Price ordinary body text as one tier, with separate surcharges for high-cost proxies, long-running interactions, OCR, and model-based structured extraction. Do not charge extra merely because a site executes JavaScript; surcharges should reflect actual resource costs and service commitments, with a user-visible cap.
TEXT.先按量，再按承诺量折扣: Start with usage-based pricing, then discount committed volume
TEXT.低门槛按量价便于试用；月套餐降低稳定用量的单价，年付再交换资金与用量承诺。公布超: Low-entry usage-based pricing makes trials easier. Monthly plans reduce the unit price for steady usage, while annual payment trades funding and usage commitments for further discounts. Publish overage prices, credit validity, concurrency limits, and automatic-renewal caps so inexpensive plans do not conceal costly additional usage.
TEXT.建议网络错误、空内容、可识别的登录或验证码页不收基础提取费；服务内部重试不重复计: Do not charge the basic extraction fee for network errors, empty content, or recognizable login or CAPTCHA pages, and do not count internal service retries as additional pages. A new user-initiated refresh of the same URL may count as a new page. Successfully retrieving content does not guarantee that every business judgment is correct; this boundary should be stated in the API contract.
TEXT.价格区间不能代替成本测算: Price ranges cannot replace cost modeling
TEXT.用代理、浏览器时间、带宽、解析、失败重试和支持成本测算每千个可计费页面的成本，再: Model the cost per thousand billable pages using proxy, browser-time, bandwidth, parsing, failed-retry, and support costs, then derive the selling price from the target gross margin. Public competitor pricing is a reference, not a cost floor. This report does not have complete billing data and cannot directly rank a provider as the ‘cheapest and best.’
TEXT.用于报价的成本公式与比较边界: Cost formula and comparison boundaries for quoting
TEXT.单位成本＝该档全部请求的资源与运营成本 ÷ 可计费成功页数；价格底线＝单位成本: Unit cost = resource and operating costs for all requests in the tier ÷ billable successful pages; price floor = unit cost ÷ (1 − target gross margin). Even when customers are not charged for failures, failed-retry costs must remain in the numerator. Plan pricing must also account for unused credits, peak concurrency, and committed service levels.
TEXT.比较实际采购成本时，用实际总账单 ÷ 满足相同业务验收条件的页面数。不要直接把当: To compare actual procurement costs, use the actual total bill ÷ pages meeting the same business acceptance criteria. Do not simply divide current public pricing by this run's task pass rate: execution dates, paid tiers, provider definitions of success, caching, and feature surcharges may differ. These are pricing-design recommendations, not current provider terms.

We compared Moli 1.1.1, Chromium, Lightpanda, Obscura, and Kitesurf on 150 page and file retrieval tasks. Moli passed 135, 10 more than Chromium. On 8 web tasks completed by every tested configuration, its mean latency was 3.41 seconds, 35.5% below Chromium.

TEXT.给 AI 一个论文链接，并不等于把论文交给了它。程序需要访问网址、取得响应，再把: Giving AI a paper’s URL does not give it the paper itself. Software must visit the address, retrieve the response, and extract the text. On a dynamic page, the text may appear only after scripts run. A PDF requires text extraction from a file. This work of turning a URL into the requested content is commonly called Web Fetch.
TEXT.输入论文地址，返回可供总结的正文。任务也可以要求商品列表、图片下载地址或原始文件: Enter a paper’s URL and retrieve text that can be summarized. A task may instead require a product list, an image download URL, or an original file.
